Definition: to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), i.e. (figuratively) depopulate; by implication, to imprison or conquer; (reflexive) to lie down (for coitus)
BiblicalUsage: tsâʻâh is the ordinary word for to tip over. It appears 4 times in Scripture, including Isaiah 51:14 and Jeremiah 2:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsâʻâh is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
